title: Gave 3 stars due to ok customer service
text: Gave 3 stars due to ok customer service. My unit did not work properly. The steam and smoke poured out of the cover through the pressure valve and the slider and at times around the lid.  It completely smoked up  my house, but I was prepared for that even if it did work properly.  I contacted customer support via a return email to their follow up email. I got a response the first business day that informed me that I must not have had the lid on right. I'm not sure how this could possibly happen since there is only one way to put it on and it has a slide lock, and was a little bothered by their "happy cooking!" response. ha!  So, I returned another email asking how they would remedy this.  In the meantime, I decided to return it as I didn't feel like going through this same experience again and I can return it to Amazon hassle free.  After I set up the return, I did get an email back from Gourmia that said I could send them a pic of the cut cord on the smoker and they would promptly send me out a new one.  I ALMOST took them up on this, but decided that I'd pass for now and just return the unit for a full refund.  Customer service was decent, but I didn't care for the item.
